goal: separability check for the four substrate v2 params (width_profile shape, lateral jitter, opacity falloff, pass scatter/rotation): each param must produce a discriminable percept alone, and its dose must order perceptually — prerequisites before any of them enter the style registry
scientist_session: drafted in-session 2026-09-10 by jeremiah; critiqued by glm-5.2 via nebius (4144 reasoning tokens) before promotion. eight findings, all applied: catches carry explicit left/right; opacity prompts decoupled from stroke geometry; all pass thresholds raised to >=4/5 at n=5 (3/5 is a coin flip, p=0.5); passes/seed controls verified and recorded; width profiles area-normalized and re-rendered (ink coverage 40.1/39.9/39.9% — confound removed); registry-ready stop condition defined; anchor-fail exclusion added. jitter_lin excluded by the geometry null result (0.0000 pixel diff at sigma 4.5 — layer-2 stamp param, not testable on vector linework)

stimulus_controls.seed_note: fixed across every level of every sweep (verified in manifest.json)
stimulus_controls.geometry: same house, same roles, only the swept param varies
stimulus_controls.pass_count: pass_scatter and pass_rotation sweeps render at passes=2 (BASE_SKETCHY) — misalignment visible by construction
stimulus_controls.width_profile: area-normalized to mean factor 1.0 so ink density does not confound shape; peak width necessarily differs across shapes (unavoidable — shape IS the difference)

stimuli_source: data/generated/substrate_v2/ (regenerated post-normalization, seed 7) — all pairs use the sweep renders as-is; params recorded in substrate_v2 manifest.json

pass_criteria.threshold_note: all thresholds are >=4/5. at n=5 a 3/2 split is p=0.5 by binomial — indistinguishable from noise, so 3/5 never counts as a pass (glm-5.2 critique, applied)

per_param.line_wobble: b4p1 >=4/5 required (stimulus validity); b4p2 >=4/5 = lateral jitter discriminable at the 1.5-to-3.0 step; b4p2 fail + b4p1 pass = JND above the adjacent step, widen steps next batch
per_param.taper_shape: b4p3 and b4p4 each >=4/5 = profile shape discriminable as such (not just taper amount); b4p3 fail + batch_3 magnitude results passing = judges read taper amount but not shape — collapse width_profile back to taper magnitude in the registry
per_param.stroke_fade: b4p5 >=4/5 required; b4p6 >=4/5 = falloff depth discriminable between 0.45 and 0.10; both failing = fade gradient below JND, drop the param or strengthen the ramp
per_param.pass_alignment: b4p7 >=4/5 and b4p8 >=4/5 = scatter and rotation are each discriminable; b4p7 pass + b4p8 fail = misalignment reads as scatter only, merge pass_rotation into pass_scatter in the registry

pass_criteria.general: any scored pair with a 50/50 judge split is a stimulus failure, not human noise: regenerate at higher parameter delta in the next batch

adaptive_rules.catch_fail: a judge answering >1 catch pair with a side choice instead of 'no difference' is excluded from aggregates; recruit a replacement to hold n=5
adaptive_rules.anchor_fail: a judge answering the anchor (b4a, extreme scatter) wrong is excluded and replaced — if the extreme step is not visible to a judge, their subtle JND judgments are noise (glm-5.2 critique, applied)
adaptive_rules.adjacent_fail: endpoint passes + adjacent fails -> next batch halves the endpoint delta (e.g. jitter_lat 1.5 vs 3.75) and probes the middle of the range
adaptive_rules.param_fail: endpoint pair failing (b4p1, b4p5) -> stimulus failure: re-render at stronger setting before any registry verdict
adaptive_rules.registry_ready: endpoint pass + adjacent pass in the SAME batch = registry-ready; no second batch required. a param passing only its endpoint waits for one confirmation batch before entering the registry
adaptive_rules.convergence: two consecutive batches with agreement values inside each other's bootstrap CIs at target n ends the loop for that param

registry_consequences.pass: param enters the style registry as a measured factor with its validated step size; extraction settings for the node canvas default to the measured JND so fitted slider deltas below JND snap to zero movement
registry_consequences.shape_collapse: if taper_shape fails while taper magnitude passes, width_profile is registry-redundant — keep it as engine sugar (one param instead of taper+taper_dir) but stop claiming shape as a separate style factor
registry_consequences.merge: if pass_rotation fails while pass_scatter passes, the registry stores one pass-misalignment factor, not two
registry_consequences.null_note: jitter_lin is already registry-excluded by the geometry null result; if a raster/stamp layer ever lands, it gets re-registered there, not in vector linework
